name: konstera
description: Your Konstera tenant in Claude: connectors, models, agents and runs, plus agent publishing.
long_description:
Gives Claude the Konstera developer tools so it can build agents against your real tenant: what connectors and models you have, which agents are deployed, how their recent runs went, and checking or publishing an agent manifest.

Ask Claude to "sign in to Konstera". Your browser opens the Konstera portal, where a tenant admin approves the request. Nothing to configure; the sign-in is kept and renewed on this computer.

tools.name: konstera_sign_in
tools.description: Sign in to Konstera; a tenant admin approves it in the portal.

tools.name: konstera_status
tools.description: Show the tenant this app is signed in to and when the token renews.

tools.name: konstera_sign_out
tools.description: Sign out and remove this app's tokens from this computer.

tools.name: agents_list

tools.name: agent_invocation_describe
tools.description: Show one agent run in full: steps, logs and errors.

tools.name: agent_manifest_validate

tools.name: agent_publish
tools.description: Publish an agent to the tenant.
